content.short: Infinex is a non-custodial trading platform featuring a CEX-like interface and seamless chain abstraction.
content.description:
Infinex is an innovative decentralized trading platform designed to bridge the usability gap between centralized exchanges and decentralized finance. Founded by the creators of Synthetix, the platform utilizes advanced chain abstraction to provide a "CEX-like" user experience, eliminating the complexities of manual bridging, gas fee management, and seed phrases. Through its secure, non-custodial architecture, Infinex allows users to trade assets across multiple networks with the speed and simplicity typically found only in centralized environments.

Powered by the INX token and supported by a global community of contributors, Infinex focuses on mass adoption by making decentralized trading intuitive for everyone. The platform leverages the security of networks like Base, Polygon, and Ethereum while providing a unified interface for asset management. By prioritizing user-centric design and technological innovation, Infinex is redefining the standard for modern decentralized exchanges and empowering the next generation of Web3 participants.
content.meta: Infinex offers a user-friendly, non-custodial trading experience with chain abstraction and professional-grade performance.
